{"path":"neuron_growth_anthropic-claude-sonnet-5_01.html","edit_description":"Create a brand-new, self-contained single HTML file (this file does not exist yet — generate it from scratch) implementing an animated neon "neuron growth network" visualization with dat.gui controls. Follow this exact specification:

STRUCTURE:
- Single HTML file, DOCTYPE html, head with title, style block, body with one 800x800 <canvas id="scene">, centered on page with flexbox on a dark body background (#05070f).
- Load dat.gui from CDN: <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/dat.gui/0.7.9/dat.gui.min.js"></script>. No other external libraries/assets/images.
- All JS vanilla, in a single <script> block at the end of body, no modules.

CSS:
- body: margin 0, height 100vh, display flex, align-items center, justify-content center, background #05070f, overflow hidden, font-family monospace.
- canvas: background radial-gradient from #101a3a (center) to #05070f (edges), box-shadow soft cyan glow (#00e5ff), border-radius small, display block.
- dat.gui panel positioned fixed top-right (default dat.gui behavior is fine), style tweak: accent color #ffd400 for dat.gui text via a small CSS override targeting .dg elements (optional, keep simple).

COLOR PALETTE (use exactly these hex/rgba values as JS config constants and dat.gui-controllable color params):
- background: '#05070f'
- backgroundGlow: '#101a3a'
- branchColor: '#00e5ff'
- accentColor: '#d6ff00'
- synapseColor: '#ff2bd6'
- pulseColor: '#fff36a'
- uiColor: '#ffd400'
- gridColor: 'rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.08)'

CODE STRUCTURE (with comment headers separating sections): "// --- Setup ---", "// --- GUI Setup ---", "// --- Neuron Growth ---", "// --- Synapse Detection ---", "// --- Pulse Animation ---", "// --- Rendering ---", "// --- Main Loop ---".

SETUP:
- Get canvas + ctx (800x800). Define a `params` object holding all GUI-tunable values with sensible defaults:
  neuronCount (3-6, default 4, integer), growthSpeed (default ~1.5, range 0.2-5), maxDepth (default 6, range 2-10, integer), splitChance (default 0.25, range 0-1), curvature (default 0.4, range 0-1), maxBranchLength (default 90, range 20-200), synapseDistance (default 28, range 10-80), synapseGlowStrength (default 18, range 0-40), pulseSpeed (default 0.02, range 0.002-0.1), pulseFrequency (default 0.02, range 0.001-0.2), pulseBrightness (default 1.0, range 0.2-3), backgroundColor '#05070f', branchColor '#00e5ff', accentColor '#d6ff00', synapseColor '#ff2bd6', pulseColor '#fff36a'.
- Global state: `branches` array, `synapses` array, `pulses` array, `growthQueue` array (tips actively growing), `paused` boolean false, `animationId`.

NEURON GROWTH SIMULATION:
- `initNetwork()`: clears state, creates params.neuronCount random seed neuron positions near canvas center (within ~120px radius jitter), each seed becomes root of a branch growth queue entry with random initial angle, depth 0.
- Each branch segment stored as object: {x1,y1,x2,y2,cx,cy (control point for quadratic curve), depth, width, colorType ('main' or 'accent'), growProgress (0..1), parentTip:{x,y}, angle}.
- Growth is animated step by step: on each frame, for every active growing tip, advance a small step (length scaled by growthSpeed) in its current angle with slight random variation (organic curve), using a quadratic control point offset by curvature for smooth bends. When a segment reaches maxBranchLength or randomly earlier, it finalizes: pushed to `branches`, and with probability splitChance spawns 1-2 child tips with new slightly varied angles (small side branches use thinner width), respecting maxDepth (stop recursing/spawning beyond it) and a global branch count cap (e.g. 260) for performance.
- Randomly vary branch stroke width slightly (e.g. 1 to 2.5) and randomly assign colorType mostly 'main' (~75%) with some 'accent' (~25%) for secondary branches.
- Track growth as finished when growthQueue empties (no more active tips) — this marks the network "stable"; keep a `growing` boolean flag.

SYNAPSE DETECTION:
- After growth (or opportunistically as tips finalize), check finalized branch endpoints pairwise; when distance between two tip endpoints (from different branches/neurons, not already connected) is below params.synapseDistance, create a synapse object {x1,y1,x2,y2,pulsePhase:random} and push to `synapses`. Use a Set or seen-pairs check (e.g. key from sorted index pair) to prevent duplicates. Keep this check lightweight (only run over branch tip endpoints, not full O(n^2) every frame — run once when growth finishes, or incrementally in small batches).

PULSE ANIMATION:
- Once network stable (growing===false), continuously spawn random pulses traveling along random existing synapses (and optionally along branch paths) at a rate controlled by pulseFrequency (probability per frame or interval-based). Each pulse object: {synapseIndex or path points, t:0..1, speed: params.pulseSpeed * random jitter}. Advance t each frame by speed; interpolate position with simple lerp (or along quadratic curve if traveling a branch) between endpoints; remove pulse when t>=1. Cap total simultaneous pulses (e.g. 40) for performance.

RENDERING (drawn every frame in this order):
1. Clear canvas, fill background color (radial gradient background+backgroundGlow already via CSS, but also fill ctx with params.backgroundColor at low alpha or solid fill then subtle radial gradient glow behind center using backgroundGlow).
2. Faint scanlines: draw thin horizontal lines every ~4px across canvas using gridColor (rgba(0,229,255,0.08)), very subtle.
3. Draw all finalized branches as smooth quadratic curves (ctx.quarticCurveTo/quadraticCurveTo using stored control point), stroke with branchColor or accentColor depending on colorType, lineWidth from segment, ctx.shadowBlur ~8-14 with matching shadowColor for neon glow. Partially-grown active tips also drawn progressively (only the grown portion via progress interpolation) so growth animates visibly.
4. Draw synapses as small glowing circles/short links at connection points using synapseColor, shadowBlur = params.synapseGlowStrength, with a subtle pulsing radius/opacity using Math.sin(time+phase).
5. Draw pulses as small bright circles (sparks) at interpolated position using pulseColor, shadowBlur scaled by params.pulseBrightness, slight trailing glow (draw a short fading line behind or use higher shadowBlur).
6. Subtle vignette: radial gradient overlay from transparent center to dark semi-transparent edges, drawn last on top.
- Always reset ctx.shadowBlur = 0 after glow-drawing steps that need it disabled for subsequent draws (e.g. before scanlines/vignette which don't need glow), to avoid unwanted glow bleeding onto flat overlays.

MAIN LOOP:
- requestAnimationFrame loop calling update (growth stepping + synapse detection + pulse spawning/advancing) then render, unless params/state `paused` is true (still allow toggling pause to freeze the visual but keep loop alive skipping updates, or simply stop calling requestAnimationFrame and store id to resume). Use a time delta or simple frame counter for animation timing.

GUI SETUP (dat.gui):
- const gui = new dat.GUI();
- Folder "Growth": neuronCount, growthSpeed, maxDepth, splitChance, curvature, maxBranchLength.
- Folder "Synapses": synapseDistance, synapseGlowStrength.
- Folder "Pulses": pulseSpeed, pulseFrequency, pulseBrightness.
- Folder "Visuals": backgroundColor (addColor), branchColor (addColor), accentColor (addColor, label "Accent Branch Color"), synapseColor (addColor), pulseColor (addColor).
- Top-level (or in a "Controls"/no folder) buttons via functions object: "Regenerate Network" -> calls initNetwork() and resets growing=true; "Clear Canvas" -> clears branches/synapses/pulses arrays and blanks canvas; "Pause / Resume" -> toggles paused and updates button label if possible (or just toggles state, dat.gui button label can stay static "Pause / Resume").
- Open all folders by default.

CONSTRAINTS:
- No images/textures, only canvas vector drawing + shadowBlur glow.
- No mention of any game/movie/brand/copyrighted visual style anywhere in code or comments — keep comments purely technical/descriptive (neurons, branches, synapses, pulses).
- Keep total code compact and readable, well-commented per section, performant (cap branch/synapse/pulse counts as noted).
- Call initNetwork() once on load to start the simulation automatically, then start the animation loop."}
